project_type: React/Vite frontend + FastAPI backend with SQLite database
build_system: npm/vite for frontend, uvicorn for backend
verification_instructions: Start backend with 'cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000', start frontend with 'cd frontend && npm run dev', test each feature manually in browser at http://localhost:5173
environment_constraints: Backend runs on port 8000, frontend on port 5173 (Vite auto-assigns). SQLite database file smartbursary.db in backend/ directory. Database tables are created via Base.metadata.create_all on first startup, not migrations. Document uploads stored in backend/uploads/
contribution_requirements: Use existing code patterns: SQLAlchemy ORM models in models.py, Pydantic schemas in schemas.py, FastAPI routes in main.py with dependency injection. Authentication uses JWT via security.py current_user and require_roles dependencies. Audit log entries via audit() helper function. Frontend is single-file React app (App.jsx) with inline component functions and styles.css for styling.
key_patterns: Backend: API routes follow RESTful conventions with /api prefix. Auth uses Depends(current_user) for authenticated routes, Depends(require_roles('admin', 'reviewer')) for role-based. Models use SQLAlchemy 2.0 Mapped annotations. Frontend: functional React components, inline in App.jsx. State managed with useState. API calls via api() helper from api.js. Navigation via page state variable. Staff variable determines admin/reviewer vs applicant UI paths. CSS uses BEM-like naming with utility classes.
directory_structure: backend/app/ contains all Python modules (main.py routes, models.py ORM, schemas.py validation, security.py auth, database.py session, config.py settings). frontend/src/ contains App.jsx (main React app), api.js (authenticated fetch helper), styles.css (responsive CSS). Database file smartbursary.db and uploads/ directory are at backend/ root.
